title: Het Grote Songfestivalfeest 2019
overview: Het Grote Songfestivalfeest 2019 was the inaugural edition of the massive Eurovision-themed concert. Hosted at Amsterdam's Ziggo Dome on December 15, 2019, it featured over 30 past Eurovision acts performing their hits. The event, presented by Edsilia Rombley and Cornald Maas, served as an unofficial celebration ahead of the Eurovision Song Contest 2020 in the Netherlands.
